response: 1 if batting half scores zero runs; 0 otherwise

fitting.schedule: refit once per calendar month from strictly earlier same-season complete games only; score all games on target date before adding outcomes
fitting.standardization: training half-innings only; mean/std; std floor 1e-9
fitting.optimizer: IRLS Newton with exact dense Hessian

probability.assumption: conditional independence of half-inning zero events given admitted pregame predictors

selection.side_rule: NRFI if p>=0.75; YRFI if p<=0.25; otherwise abstain

tuning: single frozen configuration; no lambda grid, threshold search, feature subset search, interaction search or post-result calibration
external: historical-seen development only; no pristine external claim; no external open unless development gate passes and a separate future protocol is authorized
